ryan poehling.note: Poehling (lower body) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Ducks on Wednesday.

ian moore.note: Moore (lower body) might be an option to play by the end of the week, Derek Lee of The Hockey News reports Wednesday.

aj greer.note: Greer (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.

james hagens.note: Head coach Marco Sturm announced Saturday that Hagens (back) is expected to miss multiple weeks, per Jack Studley of Boston Hockey Now.

justin danforth.note: Danforth (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Thursday, per the NHL media site.

matt grzelcyk.note: Grzelcyk (lower body) suffered a "flare-up" and could be out for at least "a few days," head coach Lindy Ruff told Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Tuesday.

kevin bahl.note: Bahl will undergo surgery for a ruptured Achilles tendon and won't play again in the 2026-27 season, the Flames announced Sunday.

jonathan huberdeau.note: Huberdeau (hip) took the ice in a regular jersey Friday, Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM reports.

jordan staal.note: Staal (calf) will be a game-time decision versus the Kraken on Saturday after head coach Rod Brind'Amour told reporters, "So, we'll find out probably tomorrow after you know gets through the morning, and hopefully he does play," per Tom Gulitti of NHL.com.

bowen byram.note: Byram (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.

lian bichsel.note: Bichsel (lower body) is expected to miss at least two games after getting injured Thursday versus the Jets, Robert Tiffin of NHL.com reports.

oskar back.note: Back was placed on long-term injured reserve on Saturday.

matt duchene.note: Duchene will be out for approximately three months after undergoing surgery to repair a core injury, the team announced Monday.

albert johansson.note: Johansson (undisclosed) will be with the Red Wings for their upcoming four-game road trip, Ansar Khan of MLive.com reports Friday.

simon edvinsson.note: Edvinsson (contract dispute) is on the Red Wings' injured, non-roster list, per the NHL media site Wednesday.

alec regula.note: Regula (undisclosed) was designated for long-term injured reserve Thursday.

matt savoie.note: Savoie (lower body) was shifted to long-term injured reserve Thursday.

frederik andersen.note: Andersen (knee) isn't expected back until "maybe" December, head coach Mike Babcock told NHL.com on Tuesday.

mattias janmark.note: Janmark (undisclosed) does not have a timetable for his return from injury.

brad marchand.note: Head coach Paul Maurice said Friday that Marchand (knee) will travel with the Panthers during their upcoming three-game road trip, Jameson Olive of the Panthers' official site reports.

aleksander barkov.note: Head coach Paul Maurice said Friday that Barkov (knee) will travel with the Panthers during their upcoming three-game road trip, Jameson Olive of the Panthers' official site reports.

jonah gadjovich.note: Gadjovich (upper body) is out indefinitely, the team announced Thursday.

brock faber.note: Faber (skull) has told the Wild that he's ready to play and expects to return for Saturday's game against the Bruins, Michael Russo of The Athletic reports Wednesday.

filip gustavsson.note: Gustavsson (hip) will travel with the Wild during the team's upcoming three-game road trip, per Joe Smith of The Athletic.

ivan demidov.note: Demidov (foot) skated Tuesday and could resume training with the team next week, Patrick Friolet of RDS reports.

sam montembeault.note: Montembeault (lower body) is considered day-to-day, according to Renaud Lavoie of TVA Sports on Saturday.

johnathan kovacevic.note: Kovacevic (undisclosed) is undergoing imaging Thursday and won't play in the Devils' home matchup against the Capitals, Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News reports.

anthony mantha.note: Mantha (throat) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Devils on Wednesday, retroactive to Nov. 7.

seamus casey.note: Casey will be out of action for 6-8 weeks after undergoing a knee procedure, Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News reports Friday.

mathew barzal.note: Barzal (knee) won't be in the lineup against the Sharks on Monday but has been upgraded to day-to-day, Andrew Gross of Newsday reports.

sean durzi.note: Durzi (undisclosed) was put on injured reserve Thursday, per Mollie Walker of the New York Post.

igor shesterkin.note: Shesterkin will require surgery and a lengthy rehab process to address his season-ending right knee injury, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports Sunday.

joe veleno.note: Veleno (lower body) was placed on long-term injured reserve Saturday, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports.

warren foegele.note: Foegele (knee) will miss 3-4 weeks, Jackson Starr of the Senators' official site reports Saturday.

william eklund.note: Eklund had surgery to repair a torn ankle tendon and will be out 10-12 weeks, Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia reports Thursday.

nikita grebenkin.note: Grebenkin (back) underwent successful surgery and is expected to miss at least four months.

elmer soderblom.note: Soderblom (upper body) is week-to-week, per Penguins PR on Monday.

bryan rust.note: Rust (lower body) will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Michelle Crechiolo of the Penguins' official site reports Thursday.

ryan graves.note: Graves (lower body) is out indefinitely and was placed on injured reserve Sunday.

quentin musty.note: Musty (upper body) was put on non-roster injured reserve Monday, according to Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News.

kyle keyser.note: Keyser (upper body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve by the Sharks on Monday, Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

jacob melanson.note: Melanson (chest) will be a game-time call for Saturday's clash with the Hurricanes, Tom Gulitti of NHL.com reports.

ryan lindgren.note: Lindgren (upper body) will be a game-time decision ahead of Saturday's matchup with Carolina, Tom Gulitti of NHL.com reports.

jared mccann.note: McCann (lower body) will be out for approximately 10 weeks, the team announced Sunday.

jake obrien.note: O'Brien (lower body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve Wednesday.

torey krug.note: Krug (ankle) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Blues on Monday, per PuckPedia.

tyler tucker.note: Tucker had arthroscopic knee surgery and will be re-assessed in six weeks, the team announced Wednesday.

miles wood.note: Wood (undisclosed) was transferred to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, David Alter of The Hockey News reports.

nick blankenburg.note: Blankenburg (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Maple Leafs on Friday, David Alter of The Hockey News reports.

max domi.note: Domi (back) was transferred from the non-roster list to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, per PuckPedia.

elvis merzlikins.note: Merzlikins is expected to miss 4-6 months to begin the 2026-27 regular season while recovering from a shoulder injury, per Luke Fox of Sportsnet.

nate schmidt.note: The Mammoth announced Thursday that Schmidt (upper body) is considered week-to-week, Cole Bagley of KSL Sports reports.

filip chytil.note: Chytil (shoulder) looks set to return to the lineup against the Rangers on Friday, Jeff Paterson of CanucksArmy.com reports.

thatcher demko.note: Co-president of hockey operations Henrik Sedin said Monday that he hopes Demko (hip) will be ready to return before Christmas, Kevin Woodley of NHL.com reports.

rasmus sandin.note: Sandin (knee) will be with the Capitals for their two-game road trip, Tarik El-Bashir of Monumental Sports Network reports Monday.

dylan demelo.note: DeMelo (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Friday.

nick bjugstad.note: Bjugstad (pectoral), Dawson Mercer, Nico Daws, Alexander Command and a pair of draft picks were traded to the Jets from the Devils on Friday in exchange for Connor Hellebuyck.
